occurrence_instants.name: occurrence_instants
occurrence_instants.value: ("occurrences"."start_at" is null and "occurrences"."end_at" is null) or ("occurrences"."start_at" is not null and "occurrences"."end_at" > "occurrences"."start_at")

work_assignment_state.name: work_assignment_state
work_assignment_state.value: ("work_tasks"."assignee_id" is null and "work_tasks"."mission_status"='unassigned' and "work_tasks"."accepted_at" is null) or ("work_tasks"."assignee_id" is not null and "work_tasks"."mission_status" in ('proposed','refused') and "work_tasks"."accepted_at" is null) or ("work_tasks"."assignee_id" is not null and "work_tasks"."mission_status"='accepted' and "work_tasks"."accepted_at" is not null)
